title: 2027 Engineering Graduate Program
content_text:
Job description
 Job Title: 2027 Engineering Graduate Program
Location: Various. We offer a range of hybrid and flexible working arrangements, including a 9-day fortnight.
Salary: $91,390.00 inclusive of superannuation
Pioneer + Protect Australia while securing your future
Who we are
Join BAE Systems and you'll be part of something bigger. As a valued member of our global colleague network, you'll bring your unique skills and perspectives to help pioneer progress and protect what matters most. You'll be trusted to play your part in delivering the advanced, technology-led defence, aerospace and security solutions of tomorrow, shaping a safer future, for all of us. From the depths of the ocean, to the far reaches of space, there's no limit to where a career at BAE Systems could take you.
Who you are
Here's what it takes to join our graduate program:
- 
Communication master: Impress us with your clear and engaging communication skills
- 
Collaboration champion: Show initiative and connect effortlessly with colleagues and clients, fostering a culture of teamwork and support
- 
Self-starter: Be able to manage your time and competing priorities effectively
- 
Fresh degree power: Hold a bachelor's or master's degree completed within the last two years.
- 
Ready to roll: Be available to start full-time work on 1 February 2027.
Please note, as a defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and either possess or be eligible to obtain and maintain one. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) are applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.
Why our Graduate Program?
Our two-year graduate program offers:
- Tailored training and development activities and hands-on projects in your chosen field
- A career mentor to help you navigate your career, set goals and tackle professional challenges
- Formal and informal networking with other early career peers to compare experiences and learn more about other projects
- A permanent role that offers a stepping stone into an exciting lifelong career.
Role Description
Launch your career at the edge of innovation as an Engineering Graduate. At BAE Systems Australia, you will collaborate with industry leaders to design and develop sophisticated solutions that powers Australia's most advanced defence and commercial technologies. This is your chance to turn engineering theory into ground-breaking, real-world solutions. When applying, you can select three (3) disciplines for which you'd like to be considered, including:
- Aerospace Engineering
- Cybersecurity Engineering
- Electrical Engineering
- Electronics Engineering
- Information Communication Technology Engineering
- Integration, Test, and Evaluation Engineering
- Logistics Support Engineering
- Mechanical Engineering
- Mechatronics Engineering
- Naval Architecture Engineering
- Production Engineering
- Software Engineering
- Structural Engineering
- Systems Engineering
Why BAE Systems?
Here you'll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work - this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. You'll be recognised for your contribution and enjoy rewards tailored to what's most important to you and your family - support for your financial and personal wellbeing, as well as a balanced lifestyle. In an environment embracing sustainable ways of working and with a strong sense of shared purpose, our supportive culture is a place you can feel you belong and proud of the difference you make.
A place where everyone can thrive
We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We know that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences strengthens our teams and is vital to the work we do. We welcome applications from all candidates and give full, fair and open consideration to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team to discuss any further support you may need. Connect with us at au.earlycareers@baesystems.au.
To learn more about our Graduate opportunities, check out our Careers page.
Submit your application by 23:59 on Sunday 18 October complete with your CV, Cover Letter, and Academic Transcript (official or unofficial).

title: Cadet Engineer
content_text:
Parkes Shire Council Cadet Engineer (PSC2222600), ApplyNow, verified 5 Oct 2026 AEST.
Seeking a Cadet Engineer while completing a Civil Engineering degree. Assist with engineering design, estimating and contract administration; support infrastructure projects across roads and civil assets; traffic impacts, Roads Act / Heavy Vehicle applications, NHVR permits.
Essential: HSC and eligibility for entry to an engineering degree via recognised distance education; NSW Drivers Licence; SafeWork NSW White Card. Highly valued: currently undertaking tertiary studies in engineering/surveying; GIS and/or AutoCAD.
CAT Program 2026: cadetship with training costs paid. Salary T4-T8 $860-$1169/week. LinkedIn post 12 Sep 2026: applications close 11 October 2026 for Cadet Engineer. Council contact email on page: Council@parkes.nsw.gov.au (general access/correction notice, not an application inbox).
Apply via ApplyNow portal.
apply_instructions: Apply online at https://parkes.applynow.net.au/jobs/PSC2222600-cadet-engineer (closing 11 October 2026 per Council LinkedIn).

title: Construction Cadets
content_text:
We are currently seeking Construction Cadets to join our Sydney team.
This opportunity is ideally suited to high-performing 2nd or 3rd year students currently studying a Bachelor of Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline at a recognised Australian university.
Our cadetship program is designed to provide exposure across key areas of pre-construction and project delivery, through structured rotations including:
- Estimating
- Contract Administration
- Engineering
- Health & Safety
- Planning & Programming
- Design Coordination
- Site Management
As a Cadet, you will work alongside experienced industry professionals, gaining practical, hands-on experience on major commercial construction projects, while building a strong foundation for a successful career in the industry.
About the Role
- Typically, 4 days per week, structured around study commitments
- Exposure to large-scale commercial construction projects across Sydney
- Mentoring and guidance from experienced construction professionals
- Structured learning and development opportunities
- Opportunity to build a long-term career with one of Australia’s most respected builders
About You
- Currently in your 2nd or 3rd year of a Construction Management, Engineering or related degree
- Passionate about pursuing a career in commercial construction
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Motivated, proactive, and eager to contribute to project teams
- Organised, reliable and able to work effectively in a team environment
Why HY? 
Our cadets are provided with real responsibility, meaningful project exposure, and the support required to develop both technically and professionally. You’ll work on landmark projects, learn from industry leaders, and become part of a collaborative and high-performing culture.
Apply Now
We are looking to hire cadets over the next six months as project requirements evolve. Students interested in future opportunities are encouraged to apply, even if they are not available to commence straight away.
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your interest in commercial construction and why you would like to join Hansen Yuncken.
Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. 
To be eligible for this opportunity, applicants must hold valid working rights.
